title: Evaluating LLM Research Agents as Tests of Return Predictability
abstract: arXiv:2611.04070v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: How often do research agents built on large language models report that they can forecast returns when the data contain no signal? We score the conclusions of four such agents as statistical decisions on the same simulated monthly return series. Without a prescribed significance level, the agents reported that their forecasts would beat the expanding historical mean in 16-44% of 110 null samples, whereas a Holm-adjusted regression test rejected the absence of predictability in 8% of the same samples. When a weak predictor was present, comparisons at matched false-positive rates did not establish a detection advantage for the three commercial agents. Instructing those agents to report outperformance only if they would reject the absence of predictability at the 5% level, accounting for every specification they evaluated, reduced their false-positive rates to 0-3%. It also reduced detection at a population $R^2$ of 1%: from 74% to 45%

translated_title: 评估基于大语言模型的研究智能体作为收益可预测性的检验
translated_abstract: 当数据中不包含任何真实信号时，基于大语言模型构建的研究智能体有多大频率会报告其能够预测收益？我们将四个此类智能体的结论作为统计决策，在同一组模拟月度收益序列上进行评分。在没有规定显著性水平的情况下，这些智能体在110个零假设样本中的16%-44%里报告其预测将跑赢扩展的历史均值，而经Holm校正的回归检验在同样的样本中仅有8%拒绝了不存在可预测性的原假设。当存在一个弱预测因子时，在假阳性率匹配的条件下，比较结果并未证明三个商业智能体具有检测优势。指示这些智能体仅在能够在5%显著性水平上拒绝不存在可预测性的假设（且考虑其评估的所有模型设定）时才报告超额表现，将其假阳性率降低至0-3%。但这也降低了在总体R²为1%时的检测率：从74%降至45%。
tldr: 该论文首次将大语言模型研究智能体的预测结论作为统计决策进行系统评估，发现规定5%显著性水平可将其在无信号数据上的假阳性率从16%-44%降至0%-3%，但代价是弱信号检测率从74%下降到45%。
en_tdlr: This paper evaluates LLM-based research agents as statistical tests of return predictability, showing that prescribing a 5% significance level reduces their false-positive rates on null data from 16-44% to 0-3%, at the cost of decreased detection power for weak signals (from 74% to 45%).
